create_solvent_from_atoms: create a Solvent object by passing an ase.Atoms object representing a solvent molecule
create_solvent_from_db: create a Solvent object by passing a solvent ID index to load from the solvent database
get_molecules_per_volume: get the number of molecules per angstrom cubed from a Solvent using the molecules_per_volume property
get_solvent_molar_mass: get the molar mass of a Solvent by summing atomic masses via the molar_mass attribute
load_solvent_with_custom_density: load a Solvent from the database with a custom density value overriding the default
